chunks: Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:

The wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام is written in all the scrolls of the Prophets, and Allah did not send any messenger except with the prophethood of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله and his legatee, ʿAlī عليه السلام.

key_terms.الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: the Prophets who received divine revelation
key_terms.صُحُفِ: scriptures or scrolls of earlier Prophets
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the designated وصي of the Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَكْتُوبَةٌ: written or inscribed, indicating established divine affirmation
key_terms.نُبُوَّةِ: prophethood, the divinely granted office of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: wilayah, divinely appointed authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in relation to the Prophets and the mission of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms, in creedal and theological terms, the centrality of the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام within the divine message conveyed through the Prophets. It presents the prophethood of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the successorship of ʿAlī عليه السلام as matters embedded in the sacred legacy of previous prophetic revelations.
